raf: Quick heads-up: scheduling a maintenance window for a thermal-driver patch in us-west clusters on Sun 2025-02-09 04:00-06:00 UTC. We'll perform staggered node reboots across 4 racks. Expected impact: brief task evictions and short-lived queueing.
maya: Are we going to pre-scale or rely on spillover? Last heatwave run had bigger tails.
tony: Plan: pre-scale by +12 nodes in our warm pool (us-west-warm) and enable 20m preemptible burst. Also shift a subset of heavy-tenants to our hot-standby in us-central during the window.
celine: For networking, we'll toggle ARP-proxy on the ToR for affected racks to reduce gratuitous ARP storm during interface flaps. Ops, can you validate no downstream firewall churn?
raf: Sequence (short): increase warm pool -> enable ARP-proxy -> cordon+drain cohort -> reboot -> kvseed -> demote warm pool. Abort if eviction rate >3% or p95 API latency >220ms for 3m sustained.
```
# excerpt
scale-up --pool us-west-warm --add 12 --duration 3h
netcfg apply --to-rack <rack> --arp-proxy enable
for rack in rackA rackB rackC rackD:
  cordon $rack --grace 240
  drain $rack --ignore-daemonsets
  reboot $rack
  postcheck run-kvseed --pool us-west-warm
```

maya: Cost check: 3h of extra warm nodes + preemptible burst ~ $0.7k. Finance ok if < $1k; tagging @opsbot to open finance approval.
opsbot: Created FIN-2271 and MAINT-8109. Notified finance@redwood and oncall@eng-sre.
ton y: Canary plan: pick 2 low-traffic external tenants and internal traffic generator. We'll monitor queue depth, p50/p95, and GPU utilization. If GPU util >92% for >5m we abort and roll back.
celine: Add routing fallback: if queue latency >160ms for EMEA origins, smart-routing should prefer eu-west pools. We'll test fallback at T-30m.
raf: Communications: short status page update + a customer note to reserved/dedicated tenants with a "no data loss" assurance. I'll draft and post to #customer-comm tomorrow.
maya: SRE oncall (tony) will run post-cohort smoke and check kernel logs for thermal OOMs. If any OOM kernel messages, abort and escalate.
ton y: I'll post cohort health summaries every 15m in this thread.
raf: Final check at T-45. If all green, start at 04:00 UTC. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
